questions.q: In which comic did the web-slinger debut in 1962?
questions.why: Spidey first swung into view in Amazing Fantasy #15, the final issue of that anthology series.

questions.q: Who co-created Spider-Man with Stan Lee?
questions.why: Steve Ditko co-created Spider-Man and designed his costume, with Stan Lee writing.

questions.q: What does Spider-Man's 'spider-sense' do for him?
options: Gives a precognitive warning of danger
Lets him read the minds of nearby people
Lets him see in the dark
questions.why: The spider-sense gives Peter a quick, precognitive warning when he is in danger.

questions.q: In the original comics, who designed Spider-Man's web-shooters?
options: Reed Richards of the Baxter Building
questions.why: Peter built the wrist-mounted web-shooters himself, a showcase of his science talent.

questions.q: In which 1973 issue does Gwen Stacy die in the comics?
questions.why: Gwen died after being thrown from a bridge tower by the Green Goblin in ASM #121, a turning point for the comics.

questions.q: In which year did Miles Morales debut in comics?
questions.why: Miles Morales first appeared in 2011 in the Ultimate Comics: Spider-Man series.

questions.q: Which actor first played Spider-Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, starting in 2016?
questions.why: Tom Holland joined the MCU as Spider-Man in 2016, in Captain America: Civil War.

questions.q: For which newspaper does the hero work as a photographer?
questions.why: Peter sells photos to the Daily Bugle, run by his foe J. Jonah Jameson.

questions.q: What is the civilian name of the Green Goblin in the comics?
questions.why: Norman Osborn, father of Harry, is the original Green Goblin and one of Spidey's worst foes.

questions.q: In which New York City borough was the hero born?
questions.why: Peter was born in Forest Hills, Queens.

questions.q: In which year did the comic event Spider-Verse introduce variants like Spider-Gwen and Spider-Man Noir?
questions.why: Spider-Verse began in November 2014 and brought many alternate-universe spiders together.
